email.body1:
Sean, saw Prove close the $40M round and launch the Prove Identity Platform, turning verification into a real-time process for businesses and AI agents.

A launch and raise like that usually open more enterprise accounts than the team can cover, and good-fit buyers go cold before a rep reaches them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Sean, quick follow-up for Prove enterprise sales.

Post-raise with a new platform in market, pipeline expectations climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your enterprise territory needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Sean, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Sean, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most right after a raise and a platform launch, which keeps a senior enterprise manager busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your enterprise motion? I'll tailor it to Prove either way.
